gaps: The sitemap only exposes 219 articles; earliest verified publication date is 2020-10-19. Pre-2020 coverage remains unresolved.

Direct archive/all HTTP probes return 403. Web extraction of /archive and /archive/2020 shows filters but no story listing or usable pagination, so historical traversal cannot establish a terminal archive.
RSS exposes only the latest ten articles with no older-page cursor; exhausting that feed is not exhausting the archive.
Sitemap lastmod values are retained as modification metadata and never substituted for publication dates.
Web extraction does not expose HTTP status. Current pages may be cached; title/date verification records the observed primary page, not a live HTTP 200 assertion.

terminal_condition.meaning: All URLs in this currently exposed sitemap were consumed; this does not establish complete publication history.

gaps: Completeness is relative to the currently exposed 768-entry official Engineering category; removed or uncategorized historical content cannot be established by this archive.
Initial minimal-header HTTP requests returned 406 for page 2 and pages 4–40. Ordinary Accept and Accept-Language headers succeeded; the complete 64-page pass replaced this incomplete attempt.

terminal_condition.meaning: Page 64 has no Next link; all 64 pages contain 12 records and sum to the reported 768.

gaps: Current Engineering category completeness is limited to its 26 topic-tagged records. The previously covered 2017 idempotency and online-migrations articles are absent from that category but present, dated, in the legacy corporate archive supplement.

Legacy engineering category and pagination pages 1–3 all redirect to stripe.dev and drop the old page number. Corporate archive entries do not supply engineering category labels, so the historical engineering-only corpus remains unclassified despite exhausting all accessible legacy blog metadata.
The corporate archive repeats one article on pages 4 and 5; URL deduplication removes it. One additional article appeared only in the sitemap and was resolved through title/JSON-LD head metadata.
Live page metadata contains 120 total posts and 26 Engineering posts; a web cached category extraction earlier showed 119/25. Counts use the fetched live HTML.
Current dev sitemap omissions are listed on its endpoint record; sitemap alone is not the current topic source of truth.
Deleted/private/unpublished or sitemap-excluded historical articles cannot be established from current endpoints.
HTML Next links stop at page13 although page14 and later numbered URLs return additional older posts; arithmetic continuation was required to reach the actual empty/repeated terminal.

21 Atom article URLs are absent from all 22 nonempty HTML latest archive pages. Their feed metadata is included; individual article body accessibility was not checked. Exact URLs are under reconciliation.feed_not_html_archive.
Completeness means all public published posts exposed by this API at the observation time. It does not establish that removed or non-public posts never existed.
Publication dates use the source local date field; source date_gmt is retained separately because local and UTC timestamps differ in some records.

https://slack.engineering/sitemap.xml redirected to https://slack.engineering/wp-sitemap.xml, whose final response was 404. No accessible sitemap was enumerated; the public posts API supplies the archive boundary.
Individual article pages were not requested; API publication and URL metadata do not independently verify each article body is currently accessible.

terminal_condition.error_message: The page number requested is larger than the number of pages available.

gaps: Historical archive remains unenumerated beyond the partial RSS/tag-feed union; per-feed terminals do not prove archive exhaustion.
Direct publication/archive/JSON/publication-sitemap requests receive HTTP 403; browser text extraction only exposes shell controls.
limit=100 and before=2026-06-09 did not paginate the RSS feed; both returned the same ten entries.
lastmod is unavailable from these RSS item fields and remains null; canonical URLs are normalized RSS links rather than article rel=canonical observations.
Publication tag RSS feeds each expose a current snapshot; their union does not prove coverage of older articles that have dropped out of every discovered tag feed.
Category discovery is bounded to 100 tag feeds and 240 seconds; any unvisited tags are listed explicitly.
HTTP 429 blocked 69 requested tag feeds; these feeds are not exhausted. Failed endpoint URLs are recorded under rate_limiting.

gaps.detail: Archive and URL date metadata exists for every record, but API fields.created_at and CMS sys.createdAt do not independently verify publication timestamps. Only five RSS pubDate values are verified. Metadata-only enumeration leaves remaining published_at fields null.

gaps.impact: Included in index from official Engineering API; absent from sitemap.
No gap in scoped Engineering index; its four pages and 15 Engineering taxonomy counts were independently exhausted and matched.
Landing page available in web extraction; Engineering REST archive supplies complete metadata. Sitewide feed is not used as completeness evidence.

gaps: Coverage is the accessible publisher archive and sitemap as observed, not proof that deleted or migrated historical posts remain present.
Sitemap lastmod is retained separately from article publication date.
Article bodies were not read by enumeration; prior_research_mention marks a locator appearing in earlier notes, not an earlier deep-read.
